name: skills
description: Agent Skills for Google products and technologies
one_liner: A library of ready-made 'how-to' guides that let an AI coding assistant correctly use Google Cloud tools instead of guessing.
buyer: A cloud consultancy or solo cloud architect who wants their AI assistant to stop making Google Cloud mistakes on client work.
business_use_cases: A cloud consultancy builds and sells a curated, extended 'AI-ready Google Cloud toolkit' plus support to clients adopting AI-assisted ops.
A platform team installs it to cut the time junior engineers waste debugging AI-generated cloud commands, framed internally as a cost saving.
A trainer sells a 'ship faster on Google Cloud with AI agents' workshop built around these skills.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid, extended pack of company-specific skill add-ons
Consulting and training on AI-assisted Google Cloud workflows

steal_this: Honestly, this is a free, Google-maintained utility repo, not a product on its own — the real business is becoming the consultant who installs and extends it for clients.
